_comment: Measured baselines for tests/static/css-contract.mjs. Every number here was measured against the tree it ships with, not chosen. A number may only go DOWN. Raising one requires a recorded justification in the commit body.
_measuredAgainst: dgoeaa/ECM_DOCS_DEV, branch claude/system-remediation-gaps-ahpmsy, measured by an actual run of tests/static/css-contract.mjs over the 19 stylesheets and 105 JS files it reads (core/ 67, modules/ 30, shared/ 8). Taken after the R-1..R-4 mobile-shell files were ported in, at which point the tree already held every metric the workstream's own baseline recorded: the .dgo-sidebar__badge fix (9px -> var(--dgo-type-floor)) that clears DGO-R5-TYPO-01, the .cc-source-list wrap that clears the inverted column cascade, and the R3-D1/R3-D3/R-D2 shell changes. Only accessibility.formControls (222 -> 225) and accessibility.labelled (193 -> 196) moved, both gains from the persona panel's markup.

overrideOverlap._comment: Class+property pairs declared in BOTH the overrides layer and a layer it overrides. This is the budget styles/index.css has always cited. The shared-layer arrangement in index.css stays accepted debt until platformAuthorityVsApp reaches 0.

important._comment: !important declarations in app.css. Each one removes a component's ability to adapt in context.

tokens._comment: orphans = defined but never referenced. undefined MUST stay 0 — a var() that resolves to nothing fails silently. shadowedByAppCss = design-system tokens redefined in the overrides layer.

typography._comment: belowFloor counts font-size declarations under --dgo-type-floor (11px, DGO-R5-TYPO-01). It must reach 0 and stay there.

colour._comment: Literal hex occurrences in app.css against tokenised colour references.

responsive._comment: invertedColumnCascades counts selectors whose column count RISES as the viewport narrows. Currently .cc-source-list only.

surface._comment: Classes defined in CSS vs present in markup. wel-* is excluded from unstyledInMarkup because core/welcome-experience.js injects its own sheet — that exclusion is itself the S-3 finding and should disappear when S-3 is fixed.

accessibility._comment: unlabelledControls excludes input[type=hidden]. labelForPairs is recorded to detect a shift away from label-wrapping, not because 0 is wrong.

accepted._comment: Known, measured, deliberately not fixed. Each needs an owner and a reason, or it does not belong here.

sharedOverridesLayer.reason: No sub-layer order is behaviour-preserving; see styles/index.css. Safe to split once overrideOverlap.platformAuthorityVsApp reaches 0.

injectedWelcomeStylesheet.reason: core/welcome-experience.js ships its own sheet outside the cascade. Finding S-3; scheduled as action 2.

ccSourceListInversion.reason: Column count rises as viewport narrows. The truncation it caused is fixed by allowing labels to wrap; the inversion is documented as intentional at app.css A-1.

_state: Clean pass. All must-be-zero metrics are 0; no metric is worse than baseline.
